intent: Fix Recorder db_schema warning 'State attributes for sensor.home_environment_manager_window_recommendations exceed maximum size of 16384 bytes' without altering gr_news_feed, queue or any other integration. Move full Home Environment Manager dashboard data from recommendation sensor state attributes into a permission-checked read-only Home Assistant WebSocket API, and update the bundled card to use it.
note: Full multi-room scientific dashboard remains intact over WebSocket; sensor keeps compact recommendation state, counts, revision and bounded legacy metadata under 12KiB. Preserve automatic announcements, climate logic, card interaction protections, existing unique IDs and canonical environment_manager only.
changes: Remove unbounded dashboard_snapshot(...) from AirQualityRecommendation.extra_state_attributes, replacing it with dashboard_api, dashboard_version and dashboard_revision for lightweight state refreshes.
Hard-budget all remaining recommendation metadata below 12KiB JSON, preserving ordinary small legacy attributes and visibly flagging truncated previews when needed.

Provide an authenticated read-only environment_manager/dashboard Home Assistant WebSocket command scoped to the exact registered recommendation sensor and POLICY_READ permission; return complete dashboard_snapshot on demand without Recorder writes.

Update the Lovelace card to discover the compact sensor marker, use hass.callWS for full snapshot, refresh only on revision changes, and retry transient connection failures without losing active selector/manual target edits.
Preserve old inline dashboard rendering in the frontend for optional compatibility during server/frontend rolling updates while no longer publishing that attribute in new server sensor states.
Add tests of huge Greek recommendation payloads and strict byte budget, complete >16KiB dashboard response and access denial on real Home Assistant 2026.10, and frontend revision/dedup/retry tests.
Do not change gr_news_feed, queue, other integrations, physical equipment logic, Home Assistant Recorder configuration, unique IDs or historical data.
Validate Python 3.13/3.14, Home Assistant 2026.10, HACS/Hassfest, Node card regression, translations, exact flattened HACS prerelease tag.
